CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 07 / 11

Demand elasticity

Income & cross-price elasticity收入與交叉彈性

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate and interpret income elasticity and cross-price elasticity; use their signs to classify normal/inferior goods and substitutes/complements.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

收入彈性正值屬正常品，負值屬劣等品。交叉價格彈性正值屬替代品，負值屬互補品；計算時保留正負號。

Income elasticity is %ΔQd/%Δincome: positive for normal goods, negative for inferior goods. Cross-price elasticity is %ΔQd of A/%ΔP of B: positive for substitutes, negative for complements.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Tea price rises 10%, coffee demand rises 5%. Cross elasticity=+0.5, suggesting substitutes. 咖啡需求隨茶價同向。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Income rises 10%, demand falls 5%. Income elasticity and classification? 收入增、需求減？
